notes.title: Announcement for the Artbook Release & Special Sale
notes.notes:
Hello Afterlife adventurers, Rootless Studio here!
We'd love to give some updates on what we are up to.

Artbook Release
Meet various concept images, screenshots, illustrations in  Digital Artbook with exclusive behind-the-scenes dev stories and game designs.
Know everything about  universe through the 94-page Digital Artbook.

Special Sale
Celebrating our Artbook release, we are going to run a 30% special sale on 8 Doors. If you don’t have 8 Doors: AAA in your library, you don't want to miss this one-week chance!

Meet us at TGS!
8 Doors is to be part of the Tokyo Game Show, one of the three biggest game shows in the industry. The show goes on for 4 days, from Sep 30th to Oct 3rd. Meet us at the TGS online!

Future Plans
We were originally planning the additional updates on the game contents. However, we have decided that it is better to quickly advance on the Switch release and then concentrate on the update. We sincerely apologize to the players who looked forward to the updates, and we promise that we will come back with another dev letter soon.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch Notes #3 & Announcement
notes.notes:
Patch Notes #3

Hello Afterlife Adventurers!

8 Doors: Arum’s Afterlife Adventure is participating in this Steam Summer Sale!
If there are any of you who had never played our game before, please don’t miss this chance!

What’s more, there will be a new patch going live today!
We’re also preparing for some content updates for Boss Rush and so on. You’ll love it for sure!

Patch Notes #3
[hr][/hr]

 Game Engine
We figured out some bugs with savings occurred due to the previous game engine. So we upgraded it to the newest version. It took a long time for us and we’re apologizing again for the late content update. Feel free to let us know any problem occurs with this patch.
 Controls with Controllers
Now it’s available to change controls on your controllers!
 Red Specter Index
The ghosts will share their stories within the Red Specter Index from now on!

[hr][/hr]
And please look forward to the upcoming patches!

If you have a problem or feedback while running 8Doors, please let us know anytime via the contacts below :)

Discord : https://discord.gg/94qFECw
Email : 8doors_support@neowiz.com

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow travelers of purgatory!


We’re here with the most recent patch notes.



Added Cloud Save
 - You can now use Cloud Save to save your progress on Steam. 
 - Please note that you will have to manually select Cloud Save for it to work, the save is not automatic.

Added guardian pets
 - We’ve added cute little guardian pets!
 - Remember the really big specter that chased you around? Well it’s a lot smaller now! 

Thurible
 - You can now upgrade your thurible to store more fugitive souls. 
 - The upgrade can be bought from Deller.

We’ve also made bug fixes, balance changes and some localization polish work as well. 



[hr][/hr]

There are additional updates on the way, and we’re excited to roll them out in the future. 
Just to give you guys an idea of what the update is going to be, it’s going to things like a new Journal to keep track of different specters and a new Boss Rush challenge mode. 

If you have any questions about the game, consider hopping on our Discord server for help from the community and us! 

Discord: https://discord.gg/94qFECw
Email : 8doors_support@neowiz.com

notes.title: Patch Notes #2 & Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Afterlife Adventurers,

This update aims to address some of the things we saw in your feedback. Thank you so much for letting us know what you think about the game!

[Cloud Save]

 We implemented a pre-update to turn the Steam Cloud Save feature back on
 Please let us know if your save file doesn’t load up properly


[UI Improvement]


 We added a feature to the UI that will make it easier to swap weapons (pictured below)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312102/466c555e37025aee5ded3b6033102ffc1422ae1a.png

 Show the location of mirror shards picked up by the player.


[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed a problem where boss events wouldn’t work properly after turning off the game during one of them
 Fixed bug which player can’t land on spinning wheel when they are in Ducroak form.
 Fixed bug where the prices would mistakenly revert back to normal after resetting your skills because the number of times skills were reset wasn’t being saved
 Fixed bug where the player had 4 potions but the HUD incorrectly displayed them having 5


We also made several other fixes and adjustments based on your feedback/reports.

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　

If for some reason the game isn’t starting or running properly, please follow the directions below.

Find the save file at the location listed below.
C:\Users[PCName]\AppData\LocalLow\Rootless\8Doors 
Zip the folder and send it to 8doors_support@neowiz.com so that we can analyze.


You’ll see us again soon with more improvements to the game, but please feel free to reach out to us anytime through Discord or email.

Discord : https://discord.gg/94qFECw
Email : 8doors_support@neowiz.com

Thanks again!

notes.title: Official release Q&A
notes.notes:
Hey guys, we’re finally releasing the full 1.0 version of 8Doors: Arum’s Afterlife Adventure!
Thank you all so much for your support, this couldn’t have been possible without your help.

Q: How much will the game cost?
A: The base price of the game is $19.99

Q: How much playtime can we expect in the full game?
A: It really depends on player skill but we’re expecting around 10~20 hours of playtime.

Q: Are there going to be achievements?
A: Yes of course! There are a total of 44 achievements for you to unlock.

Q: What time exactly will the game be released?
A: The game will be released simultaneously as written in different time zones below:

 KST : 2021.04.08 10:00
 PDT : 2021.04.07 18:00
 CET : 2021.04.08 02:00
Q: Any plans for console releases?
A: We’ve been pretty set on developing the game for PC up until this point, but expanding the game to consoles is something we’re looking forward to doing. We’ll keep you updated about this.

Q: How many in-game bosses are there?
A: There are a total of 21 bosses in purgatory. That’s 14 bosses and 7 hidden bosses, so be careful when venturing around the purgatory.

Guys again, it’s been an amazing ride for us to develop a game that we’ve dreamt of and have it finally released to the world to play. We genuinely hope that you’ll enjoy playing the game as much as we’ve enjoyed developing it.


Discord: https://discord.gg/94qFECw
Support email: 8doors_support@neowiz.com
